## Professional Introduction

I am a computer science graduate and an Applied Business Analytics master's student with interests in software engineering, machine learning, data analytics, and distributed systems. I enjoy translating technical ideas into dependable applications that solve practical problems.

My project experience spans low-level network programming, concurrent systems, REST APIs, full-stack development, databases, path-planning algorithms, and cloud-based data workflows. These experiences have taught me to approach complex problems systematically, evaluate tradeoffs, and build solutions that are both functional and understandable.
